Website Builder with No Monthly Fee

You can own a custom web site outright—no recurring hosting charges. Everbuilt Studio gives you a fully functional site for a one‑time fee, with optional maintenance plans.

How It Works for a Small Business Launch

  1. Free homepage remake – Submit your current homepage URL. We rebuild it for free; if you’re not happy, you keep the design.
  2. Choose a launch package – Pick the $2,950 Custom Website Launch Package for up to 5 pages, custom design, contact forms, and basic SEO.
  3. Design & build – We deliver a polished site in about a week.
  4. Launch – Your site goes live on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub; hosting costs $0/month.
  5. Post‑launch care – First 90 days are free. After that, you can add a $295/month or $595/month care plan, or cancel anytime.

What You Get

  • Ownership – You own the code, content, and domain.
  • Hosting – $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • Launch package – $2,950 for up to 5 pages, custom design, contact forms, SEO basics.
  • Signature package – $7,500 for unlimited sections, galleries, admin panel, spreadsheet events, email and form integrations.
  • Platform package – $15K for web apps, SaaS MVPs, mobile apps.
  • Deposit – 50% upfront; balance due at launch.
  • Care – 90 days free; optional $295/month or $595/month plans.
  • Downtime – 0 minutes downtime on flagship case study.

FAQ

Do I need a monthly hosting fee? No. Hosting is free on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, so you pay only the one‑time design and build fee.

How long does it take to launch? The Custom Website Launch Package takes about a week from start to finish.

Can I add features later? Yes. You can upgrade to the Signature or Platform package at any time, or add maintenance plans after the initial 90 days.

Next Step

Ready to own a site without monthly costs? Get your free homepage remake now.
